name: agentic-turnscape
description: A multi-agent turn-based narrative simulation game.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/content && npm run build -w packages/core && npm run build -w packages/agents && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
